an6.10:3.4: At that time their mind is quite unswerving, based on the teaching.
an6.10:3.5: A noble disciple whose mind is unswerving finds inspiration in the meaning and the teaching, and finds joy connected with the teaching.
an6.10:3.6: When they’re joyful, rapture springs up. When the mind is full of rapture, the body becomes tranquil. When the body is tranquil, they feel bliss. And when they’re blissful, the mind becomes immersed in samādhi.
an6.10:4.4: At that time their mind is quite unswerving, based on the Saṅgha.
an6.10:4.5: A noble disciple whose mind is unswerving finds inspiration in the meaning and the teaching, and finds joy connected with the teaching.
an6.10:4.6: When they’re joyful, rapture springs up. When the mind is full of rapture, the body becomes tranquil. When the body is tranquil, they feel bliss. And when they’re blissful, the mind becomes immersed in samādhi.
an6.10:5.3: At that time their mind is quite unswerving, based on their ethical precepts.
an6.10:5.4: A noble disciple whose mind is unswerving finds inspiration in the meaning and the teaching, and finds joy connected with the teaching.
an6.10:5.5: When they’re joyful, rapture springs up. When the mind is full of rapture, the body becomes tranquil. When the body is tranquil, they feel bliss. And when they’re blissful, the mind becomes immersed in samādhi.
an6.10:6.5: At that time their mind is quite unswerving, based on their generosity.
an6.10:6.6: A noble disciple whose mind is unswerving finds inspiration in the meaning and the teaching, and finds joy connected with the teaching.
an6.10:6.7: When they’re joyful, rapture springs up. When the mind is full of rapture, the body becomes tranquil. When the body is tranquil, they feel bliss. And when they’re blissful, the mind becomes immersed in samādhi.
an6.10:7.4: Those deities who were endowed with that kind of ethics passed away from here and were reborn there. I, too, have the same kind of ethics.
an6.10:7.5: Those deities who were endowed with that kind of learning passed away from here and were reborn there. I, too, have the same kind of learning.
an6.10:7.6: Those deities who were endowed with that kind of generosity passed away from here and were reborn there. I, too, have the same kind of generosity.
an6.10:7.7: Those deities who were endowed with that kind of wisdom passed away from here and were reborn there. I, too, have the same kind of wisdom.’
